items.quote: Kristina is very knowledgeable and skilled in recognizing the body mechanisms and is able to spot problem areas and target the issues to lead to healing and repair. She is gifted in therapeutic massage. Highly recommend!
Rose is the best massage person I've ever had and really makes you feel like new afterwards. She pampered me and always makes me feel special. Highly recommend her.
Madison is a great aesthetician. She's knowledgeable and helps me by giving me pointers. I've been going to her every other month for some time now and my skin has definitely improved.
